mapper.sql: b.boss_id, b.season_id, s.name AS season_name, b.name, b.description, b.difficulty, b.max_hp, b.image_url, b.reward_exp, b.reward_coin, b.status, COALESCE(b.starts_at, CAST(CONCAT(s.start_date, ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME)) AS starts_at, CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) AS ends_at, b.created_at, b.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM bosses b JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = b.season_id WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active = TRUE AND b.season_id = ( SELECT current_season.season_id FROM boss_seasons current_season WHERE current_season.active = TRUE AND CURDATE() BETWEEN current_season.start_date AND current_season.end_date ORDER BY current_season.start_date DESC, current_season.season_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND NOW() BETWEEN COALESCE(b.starts_at, CAST(CONCAT(s.start_date, ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME)) AND CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) ORDER BY CASE b.difficulty WHEN 'EASY' THEN 1 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'HARD' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, b.boss_id

SELECT
FROM bosses b JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = b.season_id WHERE b.boss_id = #{bossId}

SELECT condition_id, condition_template_id, season_id, boss_id, title, description, target_type, threshold_value, threshold_unit, target_value, required_days, unit, sort_order FROM boss_common_conditions WHERE boss_id = #{bossId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, condition_id ASC
SELECT s.season_id FROM boss_seasons s WHERE s.active = TRUE AND CURDATE() BETWEEN s.start_date AND s.end_date ORDER BY s.start_date DESC, s.season_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM bosses WHERE boss_id = #{bossId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
